long_cell_table.docx.description: Issue #155 row-split oracle: a 20-line cell row at a page bottom breaks at a line boundary (4 lines stay on page 1); the same row with <w:cantSplit/> later moves whole. Exact 14pt line pitch, explicit A4 pgSz. Expected 3 pages.

table_placement.docx.description: Issue #173 horizontal-placement oracle: four fixed-width 200pt bordered tables on A4 (1in margins, ~451.3pt column) — jc=center (left edge ~125.6pt into the column), jc=right (~251.3pt, flush right), tblInd=720 twips (36pt), and a bidiVisual table with no jc (default start = right margin, ~251.3pt; cell A rightmost). Explicit A4 pgSz. Expected 1 page.

exact_row_table.docx.description: Issue #169 <w:trHeight w:hRule> oracle: a 2-column bordered table (exact 14pt line pitch, zero cell top/bottom margins) whose second row is hRule=exact 840 twips (42pt) holding 6 lines in cell A — the row stays 42pt and lines 4-6 are clipped (not painted; our PDF drops them from the content stream too); the third row carries the same 6 lines under hRule=atLeast 840 and grows to 84pt. Explicit A4 pgSz. Expected 1 page, rows 14/42/84/14pt.
